items.title: 18.2.1 Limitations to the Law of Independent Assortment (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 18.2.1, point for point (PDF 88-89).

blocks.text: Law of independent assortment yeh samjhane mein madad deta hai ke genes kaise aage jate hain, lekin genetics ki har pecheedgi (complexity) is mein nahi aati. Misaal ke taur par:

items: Linked genes: aik hi chromosome par qareeb qareeb genes aksar ikatthe aage jate hain, azad ho kar nahi. Ise gene linkage kehte hain.

Chromosome crossover: meiosis mein homologous chromosomes ke darmiyan genetic maadde ka tabadla (exchange). Is ki wajah se gene milapon ki ratio law of independent assortment ke andaze se mukhtalif ho sakti hai.
Epistasis: aik gene ka asar aik ya zyada doosre (ghair mutaliq) genes badal dete ya daba dete hain. Epistasis bhi mutawaqqa (expected) ratio badal deti hai.
Pleiotropy: aik hi gene kai khasiyatein control karta hai. Is liye woh khasiyatein juri hui (linked) lagti hain aur independent assortment wali ratios bigar sakti hain.
Mahol ka asar (environmental effect): bohat se phenotypes mahol se bhi badal sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Do genes aik hi chromosome par bohat qareeb hain. Kya un ka dihybrid cross 9:3:3:1 dega? Kyun?
blocks.explanation: Aam taur par nahi. Linked genes gametes mein ikatthe rehte hain, is liye parental milap zyada aur naye milap kam ya bilkul nahi bante, aur 9:3:3:1 nahi milti.

items: Law of independent assortment ki hudood: gene linkage, crossing over, epistasis, pleiotropy aur mahol ka asar.
In sab se mutawaqqa ratios (jaise 9:3:3:1) badal sakti hain.
